automation_evidence.quote: The proposed system combines an agentic large language model (LLM) for clinically informed feature discovery with a compact quantum recurrent network

metric_evidence.quote: Our Model attains the highest mean AUROC (0.815), outperforming both the LSTM (0.810) and the random selection based LSTM (0.775).

summary: An LLM agent iteratively selects ICU features and severity weights for a compact QLSTM; AUROC exceeds LSTM and random-selection baselines on MIMIC-IV, with ablations on the quantum architecture rather than on a named time series obstacle.
